mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity across both consumer and business sectors, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both increase in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO increase, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), the central bank's policy stance reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) reflects strong housing market activity and consumer confidence, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong labor force growth (PAYEMS increase) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0), which signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
